audit_scope: Read-only exact-byte comparison of every linked Git worktree against the live root architecture construction candidate.

reference_subject.digest_algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes of sorted lines '<file-sha256><two spaces><repository-relative-path><LF>'

acceptance_evidence.conclusion: Paper acceptance does not accept these exact current bytes; the digest is a comparison reference only.

this audit report and this JSON artifact
selection_rule.rationale: Bind semantic architecture, accepted decisions, executable projections, book-practice bindings, and the public-distribution constraint without circularly treating reviews, assessments, or this audit as authority.

blocking_rule.expression: ALLOW_CONSTRUCTION iff A exists and is owner-accepted, W exists, W.subject_digest == A.subject_digest, every A file is present with the accepted hash, no material UNKNOWN or CONFLICT remains, and the exact task packet authorizes the construction scope; otherwise BLOCK.

definitions.A: immutable accepted ArchitectureSubject plus its source manifest
definitions.W: machine-readable SubjectBinding carried by the implementation task/worktree

blocking_rule.dirty_worktree_note: Dirty implementation files are not automatically forbidden; dirty or missing subject files are forbidden unless an exact architecture-change task supersedes the accepted subject through its decision path.

drift_classification_policy.worktree_local_change: A porcelain status entry proves a local worktree change, not who authored it.
drift_classification_policy.committed_branch_copy: A differing path without a local status entry is a nonmatching branch copy relative to the live root candidate.
drift_classification_policy.generated_or_run_evidence_path: This label is based only on an evidence-path convention; it is not proof of generator identity or authorship.
drift_classification_policy.untracked_projection_candidate: Untracked contracts/schemas are candidate projections; generated origin is not asserted without generator evidence.
drift_classification_policy.preservation: All dirty paths are treated as user-or-collaborator work and must be preserved until explicitly reconciled.

status_capture.status_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of retained porcelain lines with LF terminators
